title: COVID-19 pandemic declared
description: Borders close worldwide; the dataset records blanket entry bans as 'covid ban' from the November 2020 snapshot.

title: Qatar Hayya permit
description: Qatar requires the Hayya entry permit from almost every visitor during the FIFA World Cup (November-December 2022).

title: Croatia joins Schengen
description: Croatia becomes a full member of the Schengen Area.

title: UK ETA starts
description: The UK electronic travel authorisation starts with Qatari nationals, then extends to the other Gulf states and Jordan in February 2024.

title: Bulgaria and Romania join Schengen
description: Land border controls are lifted; both become full Schengen members.

title: UK ETA for non-Europeans
description: The UK ETA becomes mandatory for visa-exempt non-Europeans, including US, Canadian and Australian citizens.

title: ETA becomes its own category
description: From this snapshot the dataset separates ETAs from e-visas. Earlier snapshots count ETAs as e-visas.

title: UK ETA for Europeans
description: The UK ETA becomes mandatory for EU and other European visitors; it first appears in the February 2026 snapshot.
